games.name: [READ DESC] Rojutsu Blox
games.desc:
This game is current in open testing phase! Expect bugs!

Controls:
- !Party = create party
- !invite USER = invite user to party
- !accept USER = accept party
- !decline = decline party
- !disband = disband party
- !remove USER = remove player from party
- M = Open Menu
- E (Level 5+) = Cursed Mana Aura(DMG Buff)
- X = Evade (If you have enough Mana while being hit)
- M2 = Block
- M1 = Combat
- Left Ctrl = Run/Walk
- Q = Dash

Having trouble finding your way around? Open the menu, go to options, and turn on the map key!

Boss spawn every 5 minutes!
